## Chatterbox HD (Resemble AI) API

Chatterbox HD (Resemble AI) is a text-to-speech model by Resemble AI, available on the Venice API as `tts-chatterbox-hd`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

### Chatterbox HD (Resemble AI) API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tts-chatterbox-hd` | Standard | Private | $50.00 / 1M chars |

### Chatterbox HD (Resemble AI) specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Resemble AI |
| Released | Apr 17, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Voices | 9 |
| Formats | wav |

### How to use the Chatterbox HD (Resemble AI) API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/speech` with `"model": "tts-chatterbox-hd"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/speech \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "tts-chatterbox-hd",
    "input": "Private AI for everyone.",
    "voice": "Aurora",
    "response_format": "mp3"
  }' --output speech.mp3
```
